actions.reason: C0001 has coherent biological identity evidence (strong RNA inflammatory/immune pathway signal plus BAP1 mutation enrichment), cross-modal membership and boundary support from RNA and WXS with positive fused boundaries, and confounder testing showing no per-set technical factor explains membership. Structure is compatible and no material unresolved question remains.

C0002 has coherent identity evidence dominated by strong PBRM1 mutation enrichment with a distinct RNA profile, cross-modal support from WSI, RNA, and WXS with positive fused boundaries, and no per-set technical confounder. Despite weaker internal stability, the membership and boundaries remain defensible for downstream validation.

C0003 has a coherent mutation-defined identity (near-ubiquitous VHL enrichment, low PBRM1) with strong WXS-driven cross-modal support, highly stable resampling, positive fused boundaries, and no per-set technical confounder. RNA corroboration is absent but not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 has a coherent mutation-defined identity (marked VHL and PBRM1 depletion) with strong WXS-driven cross-modal support, stable resampling, positive fused boundaries, and no per-set technical confounder. RNA corroboration is absent but not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.
